title: Killer Klowns from Outer Space
tagline: In space, no one can eat ice cream!
about: A circus tent spaceship lands outside a small town and clown-faced aliens start wrapping the locals in cotton candy cocoons.
cue: Bring out the popcorn chicken when the Klown fires popcorn at Mike and Debbie.
faces: They took your wife away in a balloon? Well you don't need the police, pal, you need a psychiatrist!
Cue: Bring out the popcorn chicken when the Klown fires popcorn at Mike and Debbie.
A Klown fires popcorn from a bazooka. Crunchy chicken bites and spicy mayo.
Farmer Green thinks it's Halley's Comet. Charred franks in tortillas with pickled onion.
Watch the wall for the T. rex.
A Klown knocks with a pizza. Crisp base, tomato, mozzarella, hot salami.
Victims end up in cotton candy cocoons. Pink meringue, cream, berries and fairy floss.
Klowns sip victims through a straw. Cherry vodka, cranberry and lime soda.
The brothers hid in the truck's freezer and lived.
COMING SOON: Halley's Comet, says Farmer Green. The shadow puppet T. rex. Mooney the ventriloquist dummy. Prices subject to change. Poster and stills: TMDB.

Crunchy chicken bites and spicy mayo.How to make it600g chicken thigh fillets, in 2cm pieces250ml buttermilk150g plain flour50g cornflour2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 L vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp srirachaSoak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt.Toss the pieces in the flour, cornflour, paprika and garlic powder until shaggy.Fry in batches at 180°C until golden and cooked through.Stir the sriracha into the mayo and serve in paper cones.Farmer Green's hot dog tacosFarmer Green thinks it's Halley's Comet. Charred franks in tortillas with pickled onion.How to make it6 beef frankfurts, sliced lengthways8 small flour tortillas1 red onion, thinly sliced125ml apple cider vinegar1 tsp caster sugar100g cheddar, grated2 tbsp yellow mustard2 tbsp tomato sauce1 small bunch corianderCover the onion with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt and leave to pickle.Char the frankfurts in a hot pan until blistered.Warm the tortillas, sprinkle with cheese so it softens, and add the franks.Zigzag mustard and tomato sauce over and top with pickled onion and coriander.Shadow puppet butter popcornWatch the wall for the T. rex.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot CounterKlown delivery pepperoni pizzaA Klown knocks with a pizza. Crisp base, tomato, mozzarella, hot salami.How to make it500g pizza dough400g tinned crushed tomatoes1 garlic clove, crushed1 tsp dried oregano250g mozzarella, torn120g hot salami, thinly sliced2 tbsp olive oil1 tsp chilli flakes1 handful basil leavesSimmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt until thick, then cool.Stretch the dough into 2 rounds on oiled trays.Spread with sauce and top with mozzarella and salami.Bake at the hottest oven setting until the base is crisp and the cheese bubbles.Drizzle with oil, scatter chilli and basil and slice.Candy CaseCotton candy cocoon pavlovaVictims end up in cotton candy cocoons. Pink meringue, cream, berries and fairy floss.How to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar2 tsp cornflour1 tsp white vinegar2 drops of pink food colouring300ml thickened cream250g strawberries, halved125g raspberries30g pink fairy flossWhisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy.Fold in the cornflour, vinegar and colouring and spoon into a 20cm round on a lined tray.Bake at 120°C, then turn the oven off and leave it to cool inside.Whip the cream, pile it on with the berries and wrap the top in fairy floss at the table.Fountain and BarCrazy straw cherry punchKlowns sip victims through a straw.
